knowledge.summary: Rivera Home Electric is a licensed residential electrical contractor in Austin, TX. It performs panel upgrades, EV charger installs, whole-home rewires, and smart panel installs with written workmanship warranties.

services.name: Panel Upgrade
services.description: Replacement of a residential electrical panel, including permitting, utility coordination, and load calculation.

attributes.warranty: 5-year workmanship warranty; manufacturer warranty on the panel itself

services.name: EV Charger Install
services.description: Level 2 home EV charger installation with dedicated circuit and load management where required.

services.name: Whole-Home Rewire
services.description: Full replacement of branch circuit wiring in older homes, quoted after an on-site assessment.

services.name: Smart Panel Install
services.description: Installation of a smart load-management panel with per-circuit monitoring.
